speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these cough and shortness of breath symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been bothering me for about four weeks now, and the shortness of breath started more recently. It gets quite bad when I have to carry heavy loads while driving, and the mucus I cough up is yellowish. I haven't had a fever or any chest pain, but I do have a history of smoking. speaker: Doctor
